# M9OMS PTTini

> An open (ish) source, stripped back version of the M9OMS MyTiMic mini mic:
> PCB based, with a PTT tactile switch and a threaded
> 3.5 mm jack, in a housing designed for printing on an ordinary home FDM
> printer. Approx. 46.7 x 18.8 x 14.5 mm assembled.

It does not have the MyTiMic's PTT debounce or bypassing, but retains the
stitched ground planes. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

The PCB comes in three versions:

- QMX version: wired for the QMX, (tr)uSDX, uSDX and Pebble HF.
- KX2 version: wired for the KX2, KX3, BG2FX, FX-4CR, zBitx, sBitx and LARCSET.
- DUAL version: 4-layer PCB, wiring set by solder bridges (QMX or KX2).

## Documentation

- [Overview, print settings and parts list](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/PTTini/): what it is, print settings, parts needed, design notes
- [Housing change log](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/PTTini/STEP/changelog.html): changes between housing versions

## Files

- [BOM, Gerber and CPL](https://github.com/radio-uncensored/PTTini/tree/main/Bom_Gerber): production files for the QMX and KX2 versions
- [STEP files](https://github.com/radio-uncensored/PTTini/tree/main/STEP): top, bottom and full assembly
